releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.201: Home Screen widget buttons now expand equally to the available widget width. The widget can be resized from the Home Screen, and text size and left/right padding adapt to the available width; manual resizing is horizontal only. Individual 3D press feedback and all four independent shortcuts are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Removed the temporary Web Update 363 test label from the Me screen. No other Diary feature or APK change.
